methodology.dnp_treatment: Missing game weeks in a complete player log count as zero/DNP; byes are included
limitations: This is a 2025 descriptive baseline, not a 2026 projection.
Weekly positional ranks are calculated inside the tracked candidate pool, so fringe Top-36 rates can be slightly optimistic.
Weeks 1-17 are used; Week 18 is excluded to avoid rest-driven championship distortion.
methodology.ranking_basis: Season rank uses total PrimeTime-scored points across Weeks 1-17
methodology.scoring: 2026 PrimeTime Sleeper scoring applied to 2025 weekly Sleeper game logs
methodology.variance: Player variance is population variance across games played; cohort variance is population variance across season totals
methodology.weekly_rank_pool: Top 60 Yahoo 2025 season-ranked candidates per position, mapped to Sleeper
